behavior: Each metadata Registry owns a thread-local invalidation flag; constructing, writing, clearing or replacing one cannot erase or leak another flag.
execution_flow: Registry.new -> init creates own thread-local -> property reads/writes current-thread flag -> existing signaling/reset consumers read that registry flag.
inputs_outputs: Two registry metadata keys and two threads; fresh/lookup/replacement and setter transitions match the pinned reference property bodies.
side_effects: Only instance/thread flag storage changes; cache invalidator remains process/thread scoped; no SQL, migration, module state update or loader implementation.
dependencies: Existing Registry factory, LRU/reentrant lock and threading.local
consumers: Metadata registry factories and singleton callers
installed_mechanism: Existing Registry class and thread-local storage; no new store, scheduler, registry or Provider change.
existing_adaptation: Module cache state stays shared with its actual process-level invalidator; this unit separates the registry-change flag only.

verification.reference_comparison: PASS: extracted pinned init assignment/getter/setter traces match; no native Odoo runtime claim
verification.annulment: Expected FAIL exit1 when old property restored in process memory; source files unchanged
verification.admission: Real hooks PASS; initial rejected working-tree candidate and one invalidated comment retained as evidence
verification.index_safety: Exact tested index blobs committed with ordinary pathspec hooks, original claimed working bytes restored in finally

consumer_paths.scope: signal_changes/reset_changes per-registry dispatch and reset, with SQL blocked; no database signaling acceptance

equivalence: Verified bounded registry flag initialization/get/set/replacement/thread behavior. Not whole property/caches/loader acceptance.
limitations: No physical PostgreSQL or cross-process signaling acceptance
Shared process cache lifecycle is retained, not declared equivalent per database
Other unpublished Registry edits remain preserved and excluded from the functional commit
Whole ORM structural and contractual populations remain incomplete

integration.publication: Normal push exit0 to existing PR109; remote observation separate

acceptance_criteria: Fresh and cached metadata factory preserve intended instance identity
Second registry construction and replacement do not erase another flag
Writes and clears remain independent by registry and thread
Module cache invalidator remains connected to Registry.cache_invalidated
No unsupported loader request can be treated as installed/accepted
